original.scored_text:
Your component has `standalone: true`, so add `NgIf` or `CommonModule` to **its own `@Component.imports`**, not just `AppModule`.

According to page 1, this error requires the corresponding `NgIf` directive or `CommonModule` in the component’s imports.

For example:

```typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-categories-style-three',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './categories-style-three.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./categories-style-three.component.scss']
})
```

Alternatively, import `NgIf` from `@angular/common` and use `imports: [RouterLink, NgIf]`.

Your existing `*ngIf="trendingCategories"` can remain unchanged.
